versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the function-verification skill.
- Supports itemized functional acceptance against checklists and test cases.
- Delivers three-level conclusion: ✅Pass / ⚠️Conditional Pass / ❌Fail.
- Structured output with defect tracking, severity classification, and clear test result logic.
- Tailored for acceptance checklists, modular grading (P0/P1/P2), and defect management.
